title: A problem of Andrews and Dhar on partitions
summary: This paper is motivated by a broad question about AI-assisted mathematics: can an AI system help discover and certify an explicit bijection between two infinite sequences of complicated combinatorial sets already known to be equinumerous? The challenge is to find a reversible structure explaining that equality uniformly across the sequence. We give an affirmative test case in the setting of a partition problem.
